title: Nehai the Arbelite
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Yehoshua ben Perachya’s av beit din (head of the court). They received the tradition from the Pairs: Yose ben Yoezer of Tzereida and Yose ben Yochanan of Jerusalem, as in Avot, chapter 1, mishnayot 6 and 7. His precious saying remains with us: “Keep far from a bad neighbor, do not associate with a wicked person, and do not despair of retribution.”
In Chagigah, chapter 2, mishnah 2, he disagrees with Yehoshua ben Perachya about laying hands on an offering on a festival, and says that one should lay hands.

notes.text: Hyman’s printed heading reads נהאי (Nehai), rather than נתאי (Nittai).
